title: KARL MAYER - LinkedIn
content:
Overview:
KARL MAYER is a mechanical engineering company that offers a wide range of products and services of its sector with the focus on textile machinery building. The business activities are concentrated on the fields of warp knitting, technical textiles and warp preparation for weaving. KARL MAYER supports the success of its international customers with products and services that are outstanding in both economic and technical terms, as well as with innovations that move the textile world forward. KARL MAYER has employees all over the world. Thanks to its global organization and its claim to produce in its main markets, the company is always close to its customers and their needs. Today, it has subsidiaries in the USA, India, Italy, Hong Kong, Japan, China, Turkey, India and Switzerland, as well as agencies in all parts of the world. KARL MAYER is a German family-owned company, which has focused on financial independence and economic sustainability since its foundation in 1937. As a permanent, reliable partner with decades of experience and a high level of quality in all areas, it supports the competitiveness of its customers and business partners. title: Karl Mayer opens Textile Innovation Center
content: Karl Mayer will present the full capabilities of the Textile Innovation Center to customers, partners and the international trade press during its opening event week in Obertshausen from 21 to 24 April 2026, taking place in parallel with Techtextil Frankfurt. Karl Mayer is reinforcing its commitment to innovation with the opening of its new Textile Innovation Center (TIC) in Obertshausen. The facility reflects the company’s belief in the continuing value of textiles and aims to support customers and partners in developing high-performance fabrics and next-level textile solutions for a rapidly evolving market. The company views performance textiles as important drivers of growth for its customers and as potential game changers for the wider textile industry. It is designed to bring together brands, manufacturers and technology partners, enabling them to work directly with Karl Mayer specialists to explore new applications and constructions. Customers working in the TIC collaborate directly with Karl Mayer’s textile specialists, who bring decades of experience across markets ranging from fashion and sports textiles to highly specialised technical applications.
